text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so begins the journey of racing 
through the Twinkle Series 
alongside the horsegirl under my care. 
The name of the one walking beside me is—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis. 
I place myself in your care.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I shall overcome my frail constitution and 
bloom 
magnificently upon the battlefield of the 
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And in doing so, make our club 
the most beautiful garden of all—without 
fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series 
alongside <chrname> 
had begun!
